name: #5017 accepted exception (#4690 link instant; pin-only link instant is #5089): A (1d, closed) -FS+lag-> M (signed off Mon 2026-03-09, no hand-back) -FS+2d-> B (1d) on a Mon-Fri calendar. The pin puts M at the start of Monday on every row (milestone_at_day_end false); a calendar-day lag out of M counts from the earliest midnight equivalent to Mon 00:00 that a completed predecessor proposes. Hand-computed: row 1 (A Fri, lag 0) B Mon 03-09; row 2 (A Fri, lag 1) B Tue 03-10; row 3 (A Mon, lag 0) B Wed 03-11. A later A finish or a larger lag moves B later, never earlier. Project finish Wed 03-11.
